rationale: Revised plan eliminates target leakage by removing billed_amount and allowed_amount from the feature set, retaining only submission-time features (claim type, place of service, provider specialty, utilization and clinical indicators). This addresses the critical leakage issue that inflated ROC-AUC values above expected range. The feature set now contains: claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, service_units, length_of_stay, er_flag, elective_flag, preventive_flag, auth_required_flag, primary_icd10_cm, and drg_present. Added model_limitations caveat to the write_report component to communicate model limitations to stakeholders. All other parameters remain unchanged: p90 threshold on paid_amount computed on training data only, logistic regression and gradient boosting models, preprocessing fitted on training data only, show_denominators and cite_artifacts enabled for reproducibility. Retrieved skill evolved_run_006_001 continues to ensure synthetic_data caveat is included in the report.
changes_summary: Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from feature_set to eliminate target leakage of cost information unavailable at claim submission time. This correction uses only submission-time features, which should bring ROC-AUC values into the expected range [0.6, 0.95]. Added model_limitations caveat to report to communicate model limitations as a baseline expectation.
